name: Sannomiya Seijun
source:
A student who serves as the president of the tennis club to which Ayumu belongs.

He is the son of a doctor and comes from a wealthy family. His handsome, charming appearance also makes him quite popular among the female students.

To Ayumu, he is a kind and dependable senior.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11700]the official site[/url]]
